findings.description: Parse `stdout` into `unknown` and narrow before accessing `hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecision`. `JSON.parse` returns `any`; accessing properties on the result bypasses type checking at this I/O boundary, violating the project's no-`any` rule.

Validate each parsed JSONL line against the `Row` shape before casting to `Row[]`. `.map((l) => JSON.parse(l))` produces `any[]`; the corpus file is an external I/O boundary that requires `unknown` + narrowing per project convention, not a bare cast through the array type annotation.
